scorecard.rationale: Coconut-containing experimental diets changed laboratory motor performance, and one extra-virgin oil ALS experiment timed grip endurance on a grid. The Parkinson dietary crossover used a coconut-derived fraction and lacked a fall-frequency contrast. Refined coconut oil and spontaneous Parkinson falls remain open. The 2017 coconut oil association concerns total PRO-PD with grade unspecified. The later review repeats the same association and adds no refined-oil fall count or novel participating cohort.
